brief: Trial NCT03684694 (ADC Therapeutics). Why did it stop, and was the drug it tested (loncastuximab tesirine) ever approved by the FDA, and when?

findings.claim: Trial NCT03684694 sponsored by ADC Therapeutics S.A. was terminated.
Trial NCT03684694 stopped for the exact why_stopped reason "Administrative decision", categorized as business/strategic.
Trial NCT03684694 start date was December 1, 2018, primary completion date was November 8, 2022, and completion date was November 8, 2022.
Trial NCT03684694 results are posted on ClinicalTrials.gov (results_first_post_date: 2024-02-06, results_due_date: 2023-11-08, days_late: 90).
The drug tested in trial NCT03684694, loncastuximab tesirine (marketed as ZYNLONTA, BLA 761196), was approved by the FDA on April 23, 2021.

tool_calls.name: query_trials_sql

args.sql: SELECT t.nct_id, t.title, t.sponsor, t.phase, t.overall_status, t.why_stopped, d.why_stopped_category, t.start_date, t.primary_completion_date, t.completion_date, t.enrollment, d.results_posted, t.results_first_post_date, d.results_due_date, d.days_late, t.interventions, d.drug_names FROM trials t JOIN trial_derived d USING (nct_id) WHERE t.nct_id = 'NCT03684694'
